Interface ReactiveFluentCassandraOperations

All Superinterfaces:
ReactiveDeleteOperation, ReactiveInsertOperation, ReactiveSelectOperation, ReactiveUpdateOperation
All Known Subinterfaces:
ReactiveCassandraOperations
All Known Implementing Classes:
ReactiveCassandraTemplate
public interface ReactiveFluentCassandraOperations extends ReactiveSelectOperation, ReactiveInsertOperation, ReactiveUpdateOperation, ReactiveDeleteOperation
精简的接口，提供对流畅式 API 的访问，该 API 定义了一组基本的响应式 Cassandra 操作。
Since:
2.1
Author:
马克·帕卢赫
